key_observation: Per-edge provenance recall compounds through reachability: in the toy DAG, observed edge recall controls of 0.85 and 0.95 yielded only about 0.747 and 0.913 descendant-set recall. A complementary static map can materially reduce stale descendants, while its false positives mainly spend away local-replay efficiency. Recovery routing should therefore use closure-level safety plus static recall/FP and independent-work fraction rather than raw edge accuracy.
public_implementation_observation: The inspected Auditable LangGraph adapter explicitly marks whole-state accesses as overcaptured, warns when Runnable nodes pass through uncaptured, does not capture conditional-routing reads in the current round, and rejects unsupported non-mapping state schemas. This provides concrete implementation-level false-positive and false-negative provenance modes.
